subject: SIG request: artifact hand-off + RBAC screenshot clarification
messages:
From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@zephyrhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: security@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG packet + evidence request for SOC2 readiness

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick heads-up on the SIG. Our compliance team is doing a desktop review ahead of the procurement board next week and we need the following artifacts from Redwood to close the initial checklist: 

- Completed SIG questionnaire (responses only) or exported PDF
- Access / IAM policy screenshots showing RBAC roles and an example admin user
- Network topology diagram (ingress/egress controls, VPC peering if applicable)
- A short runbook or screenshot that shows the incident response play for a suspected data exfiltration event
- Evidence of SOC 2 scope (link to current SOC 2 or confirmation of SOC 2 in scope)

Can you share these as Drive links (view-only preferred) and point me to any notes about redaction or sensitive screenshots? Target to have the folder by EOD Thursday (14 May) would be ideal for our gating process.

Also, if any items are NDA-only, flag them and we can follow the secure delivery flow.

Appreciate it — Sam

--
Sam Peterson
Security Operations Lead, Zephyr Health
sam.peterson@zephyrhealth.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG packet + evidence request for SOC2 readiness

Sam — thanks for the checklist and the timeline. We can deliver an initial evidence bundle by EOD Thu 14 May. Plan below: 

1) Completed SIG responses (PDF) + index of artifacts.
2) Drive folder with subfolders: IAM-screenshots, Network-diagrams, Runbooks, SOC-engagement.
3) RBAC screenshot(s): we will include an admin console capture and a minimal redacted view for user listings.
4) Runbook excerpt showing the incident response play — we will provide the section and a screenshot of the run execution steps.

Two quick asks from our side: 
- Confirm whether view-only Drive links are acceptable for initial review (we can also provide expiring links).
- Do you need signed/verified SOC 2 or is a scope statement sufficient for the board next week?

I’ll assemble the bundle and notify you when I share. Looping in Neha (compliance) and Vivek (platform) to help pull the screenshots and diagram.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
(Attachment: SIG_response_template.xlsx)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG evidence bundle posted — Redwood -> Zephyr (Drive links)

Sam — bundle is posted. Summary of what’s in the shared folder below and a couple of notes on redaction/PII: 

Shared folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D4E_exampleSIGShare

Folder contents: 
- SIG_Responses_Redwood_v1.2.pdf (completed questionnaire; response-level detail)
- IAM-screenshots/runbook_rbac_step_by_step.pdf (step captures + explanation)
- IAM-screenshots/rbac_admin_console_20260514.png (admin console view, usernames redacted)
- Network-diagrams/network_diagram_app_infra_v2.pdf (VPC boundaries, ingress/egress controls)
- Runbooks/incident_response_exfil_playbook_excerpt.pdf (excerpted runbook; sensitive internal endpoints redacted)
- SOC2/README.txt (scope statement + auditor contact)

Notes: 
- We redacted specific user account identifiers in screenshots but left role names (Admin, Platform-Engineer, ReadOnly) so you can validate role coverage.
- If you require raw logs or unredacted screenshots for audit, we can provide those under a secure exchange (let me know person and email).

Attachments: SIG_Responses_Redwood_v1.2.pdf, runbook_rbac_step_by_step.pdf, network_diagram_app_infra_v2.pdf

Please confirm receipt and if the RBAC screenshot granularity is sufficient.

Thanks,
Tessa
From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence bundle posted — Redwood -> Zephyr (Drive links)

Tessa — thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the bundle and the questionnaire PDF looks good. A couple of small follow-ups before I send to our procurement board: 

1) Can you provide one additional screenshot showing an explicit admin user assigned to the Admin role (you can blur the username but we need the mapping visible)?
2) For the incident runbook excerpt — can you include a brief timestamped example (screenshot) of an exercise or incident run (redacted) to confirm playbook execution?

If you can drop those two assets into the IAM-screenshots and Runbooks subfolders by EOD today (15 May), that would be ideal.

Sam
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Sam — looping in as promised. I uploaded two additional artifacts to the shared folder: 

- rbac_admin_console_20260514.png (new image showing role-to-user mapping; usernames blurred)
